## Appearance

Matthew Cuthbert is an odd-looking man with an ungainly figure, stooping shoulders, and kindly brown eyes. He wears long iron-gray hair that touches his shoulders, along with a full, soft brown beard that he has kept since he was twenty years old, though his hair has grown noticeably grayer over time.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P34](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P26](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0026)_

## Personality

Matthew Cuthbert is an exceptionally quiet, shy, and reticent man who hates going among strangers or into places where he might have to talk. He holds a deep dread of women—with the exception of [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel—due to a fear that they are secretly laughing at him, and he possesses a mortal dread of little girls. Known for his patience, wisdom, and hard-working nature, he never seeks out excitement and rarely volunteers information. Despite his reserved disposition, he is a good-natured, sympathetic listener who enjoys talkative people when they lead the conversation. He is also described as indulgent, admiring, and possesses an amazing silent persistency when holding fast to an opinion.

## History

Matthew Cuthbert, a quiet man with a full soft brown beard who had a weak heart, decided alongside his sister [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to adopt an orphan boy to help on their farm at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). However, when he went to [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) to pick up the child, he discovered an orphan girl named [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) had been sent instead and brought her home. Though [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) initially insisted on sending her back, Matthew gently suggested keeping her. Over time, he offered quiet encouragement and support to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), secretly visiting her room to convince her to apologize to a neighbor after a punishment, surprising her with sweeties, and convincing [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let her attend social events. Noticing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was dressed more plainly than her peers, Matthew flusteredly attempted to purchase a dress with puffed sleeves for her, ultimately getting assistance to give her the stylish outfit and slippers for a school [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert. He took great pride in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as she grew up, emotional over how much she meant to him and celebrating her educational successes, including her earning a spot at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) and winning the Avery Scholarship. Shortly after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returned home from Queen's, Matthew suddenly collapsed and died after reading a notice regarding the failure of the Abbey Bank.

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--matthew-cuthbert.md)

Matthew and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shared a close bond as best friends from the moment he brought her home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Despite Marilla's initial shock that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was a girl instead of the expected boy, Matthew gently advocated for keeping her. He supported [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in quiet ways, such as secretly visiting her room to gently persuade her to apologize to Mrs. Lynde during a punishment, and surprising her with chocolate sweeties after she made friends with [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md).
